scope: All 17 tradeable First Aid outputs across four sections

rules.gold_scale: Fixed frozen Hellscream cohort anchors or qualified completed sales.
rules.reagent_floor_role: Exact audited 3.3.5 recipe cost is a separate craftability diagnostic and does not automatically set market value.
rules.sparse_sale_rule: Low-confidence completed sales receive 25% weight, or 50% when they span at least two buyers and two UTC days; the balance remains the reviewed cohort fallback.
rules.stackable_medium_gate: At least 20 units across four completed auctions, two buyers, and two UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.boe_medium_gate: At least four completed buyouts, two buyers, and two UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.comparison_retry_rule: After the initial batch, wait 2, 5, and 10 seconds and retry only failed comparison requests before recording a final failure.
rules.batch_yield_rule: Bandages and Powerful Anti-Venom create one finished item; Anti-Venom and Strong Anti-Venom create three. Exact recipe cost is divided by the minimum guaranteed output.

First Aid-only Wrath bandages.anchor_source: Rounded median Target from the frozen pre-Phase-2 Blacksmithing band inside this comparable cohort.
